body.x: Prolab introduced its coding software "Proteus" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Proteus is software designed to teach coding to kids to adults. As the governmental policy to train more engineer is taking effect, the use of this software is expected to increase. Prolab exhibited at KES to introduce the coding industry to the public.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
